The unique candidate ref is S4 dd7def6e, advanced after its actual complete hosted locked run passed all 36 suites and 1654 tests with zero failures, errors, skips, expected failures or unexpected successes. D6 separately completed three fresh same-S4 native finite evaluations: two v2 points clear, unchanged none control retaining four real intersections. C2 36/1641 success and S3 D5 1653/1654 with one generated-entrypoint failure remain separate historical executions. D4 completed all six frozen original-v4 KEY trials, strict resume and a fresh ORTHOGONAL evaluation; STOW half/full retain four intersections each. Original SLIDE r3 retains 11762 clear, 10 conservative unresolved and 9 top-level evaluation failures. L1 completed all 89 exact original calls from 19 nonclear pairs, with 505 per-case materials and 1010 exports. Source-derived interpretation identifies four finite whole-body positive Common states for A_BACK_PANEL against L/R_KEY in the declared nominal rigid SLIDE pair domain; no new full-factory or physical test is claimed. SEATING clears only its stated zero-KEY/crosshead external-pair domain. Older three panel strategies retain 4/5 original probe acceptance; new N1/N2 storage failures and N3 original wall stop precede every recorded solve and residual. C2 native KiCad research artwork passed with 52 terminals and 130 tracks, with no actual OEM binding and no S4 native KiCad rerun claim. Same-specimen 10-field/7-role/12-interface inputs, selected OLED/FPC, current EP5 structure/tolerances and physical G3-G5 remain open. Every product release flag stays false.

## Product and platform

Equal finished A/B envelopes; one approximately 7-inch flexible main OLED; flat storage in B; B moves upward 79.75 mm and seats normally by 8.20 mm; A has larger-cell priority. The 4700 mAh target uses cell-label sum at a common reference voltage; it is not verified terminal Ah for an unknown pack topology and is not a selected cell pair.

The implementation baseline is `a1b3cc1e0773446f2e36d0a607edf61211dd9919`. The donor reuse design decision and unknown physical identities are in [product interfaces](design/product_interfaces.json); project geometry and reservation assumptions are in [product geometry](design/product_geometry.json).

## Validation and research boundaries

S4 actually passed 36 locked suites / 1654 tests in one complete hosted verifier execution, with all failure/error/skip/xfail/xpass counts zero. All 6895 present source/input paths were unchanged and matched S4, 1208 Python files parsed, all 13 changed source identities and 43 locked package versions verified, and real INT/TERM cleanup passed. Three separately executed same-S4 native jobs evaluated 35343 fresh pairs and retained 70686 journal events: two v2 finite points clear, default none four positives. The candidate ref was actually advanced to S4 with an expected-old-SHA guard and independent API readback. D4 and L1 completed their declared diagnostics on C2 without granting full motion or physical qualification. The historical C2 research workflow is separately recorded and is not converted into a pass by D4/D6. ## Actual build and measurements

Formal collection on 2026-10-20 used the existing Pocket4 ADB service at 127.0.0.1:5061: 17 read-only commands succeeded, transport ID stayed 37, server boot/PID/start identity stayed unchanged, and source/design inputs matched exact f4db100. The imported record retains XT2551-3 only; ten other identity fields remain null, no seven-role physical inventory is supplied, and all 12 physical terminal interfaces remain unbound. ro.boot.hwrev is empty and is not converted into a board revision. Earlier software observations (3430/1140 mAh design values, 4570 mAh sum) and Chinese OEM manual values (4700 typical / 4540 rated mAh) keep their own dates and distinct scope. They do not prove the 4700-mAh layout. Actual board/module labels, dimensions, COF, cells/tabs/swelling, terminal topology, RF/thermal space and modified-phone measurements are still required. See engineering/product-integration-20261018/phase3-20261020/hardware/DONOR_IMPORT.md. Current 2026-10-25 execution environment has no adb executable and its historical local endpoint 127.0.0.1:5061 refuses connection; no new device commands or physical measurements were performed. This is recorded in engineering/engineering-integration-20261025/EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT.json and does not invalidate the original donor observation.

Study CAD can be generated and unpowered research coupons can be prepared while physical inputs remain incomplete. A study export does not assert whole-phone fit, electrical operation or a completed physical test.

Full implementation commands, generated outputs and measured/rejected results are in [the integration delivery](engineering/product-integration-20261018/README.md). Historical entry points remain available at the recorded baseline commit and in the original experiments.
